request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change his clothes and skin: the brown tunic becomes a short sleeveless orange-brown leather vest open over a bare green chest and belly, and an orange-brown leather loincloth, with bare green arms and legs; the striped headband becomes a plain orange-brown leather headband; one small rusted iron shoulder plate. His skin a deeper, darker true goblin green. Keep the face, ears, dagger, belt, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
